items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Catherine Russell with me today...

ctx.x: Catherine was interviewed on October 26, 2018 in Utica, NY by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Catherine Russell with me today in Utica, before a gig at Hamilton College. Welcome.
